payout_quote: Official Society6 blog 'How to Choose an Artist Plan': 'The Free Plan — Price: Free! Plan Highlights: Upload up to 10 designs in your Artist Studio — Earn 10% of the net sale on every product sold.' And: 'artist earnings for most products are 10% of the retail price.' 'Society6 pays you 10% of the products you sell, except for art prints, canvas prints, and framed prints. Those products allow you to make more by setting your own custom markup.'
steps: Create a free Society6 artist account (Free Plan).
Upload up to 10 designs; enable them on Society6's product catalog.
Customers purchase; Society6 handles production, shipping, and service.
Earn 10% of the net sale on most products (custom markup on art/canvas/framed prints).
catches: The Free Plan limits you to 10 designs; paid plans ($4.99/mo Basic, $12.99/mo Pro) allow more uploads and price control.
10% of net sale is a small cut; art prints/canvas/framed prints allow custom markup for higher earnings.
Highly variable; most artists earn little; income depends on designs and traffic.
You must own the rights to uploaded artwork.
biggest_catch: The free tier caps you at 10 designs and pays just 10% of the net sale — meaningful earnings require either many sales at 10% or upgrading to a paid plan for custom pricing, and most artists earn little.
eligibility: 18+; original artwork you have rights to.
timing: Earnings paid per Society6's artist payment schedule.
